# Cenvero Fleet

> Cenvero Fleet is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later), self-hosted fleet manager for Linux, macOS and Windows servers. A single controller binary (`fleet`) manages agents (`fleet-agent`) over encrypted, host-key-pinned SSH — in direct mode, or in reverse mode where the agent dials out so servers behind NAT need no inbound ports. There is no cloud account or hosted control plane.

It provides persistent shells, concurrent commands across the fleet or a tag group with JSON output, chunked/parallel/checksummed/resumable file transfer, live directory sync, services, logs, journald, metrics, alerts, Slack/webhook notifications, jobs, cron, drift detection, a terminal dashboard, a dual-pane terminal file manager, and a localhost web UI. Safety features include fail-closed scoped RBAC tokens, encrypted named secrets, an approval queue, command policy, a dead-man's switch (`fleet guard`), signed anti-rollback updates and a hash-chained audit log.

AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) can operate it: `fleet skill claude` installs a /fleet command, `fleet context` prints the complete CLI reference generated from the installed binary, and `fleet ai <command>` gives machine-readable help for one command.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fleet.cenvero.org/): overview, install commands, features, FAQ
- [Documentation](https://fleet.cenvero.org/docs/): install, configuration and every command
- [Agentic AI](https://fleet.cenvero.org/agentic.html): letting AI agents operate servers safely
- [What's new](https://fleet.cenvero.org/whats-new.html): release notes

## Install

- macOS / Linux (Homebrew): `brew tap cenvero/fleet && brew install cenvero-fleet`
- Linux / macOS (script): `curl -fsSL https://fleet.cenvero.org/install | sh`
- Windows (elevated PowerShell): `irm https://fleet.cenvero.org/install.ps1 | iex`
